questions.question: Demonstrate how insertions, deletions and mutations can be detected / using dot plots.
questions.solution_html:
• Demonstrate how insertions, deletions and mutations can be detected using dot plots.
  • A dot plot compares two sequences ((1 mark))
  • A continuous diagonal shows sequence similarity-(1 mark)
  • An insertion may cause a shift in the diagonal-(1 mark)
  • A deletion may also cause a shift or break-(1 mark)
  • A substitution may interrupt or weaken the diagonal- l mark.
questions.final_answer: A substitution may interrupt or weaken the diagonal- l mark

questions.question: Explain the role of eDNA and geospatial analysis in biodiversity / assessment.
questions.solution_html:
• Environmental DNA (eDNA) is DNA collected from samples such as water or soil- (1 mark).
  • Role-It helps detect species from environmental samples, It can identify species that are difficult to
  • observe, GIS maps species locations and habitats, Combining eDNA and maps helps monitor
  • biodiversity and plan conservation- (4 marks).
questions.final_answer: biodiversity and plan conservation

questions.question: Describe the application of bioinformatics in pharmacogenomics and / predicting adverse drug reactions.
questions.solution_html:
• reactions.

  • variations- (1 mark), This information can help to predict side effects or poor drug response- (1 mark).
  • It supports safer drug choice and suitable dosing- (1 mark).
questions.final_answer: It supports safer drug choice and suitable dosing
